description: This file defines a static helper class 'OptionHelper' that provides utility methods for creating and validating command-line options using the System.CommandLine library.

classes.name: OptionHelper
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods to create command-line options with default values and validation logic.

methods.name: CreateOption
methods.description: Creates and configures a command-line option with optional default value and validation.

methods.name: Validator
methods.description: Validates the option value using a provided predicate and returns an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: OnlyStrictlyPositive
methods.description: Checks if an integer value is strictly positive (> 0).

methods.name: OnlyPositiveOrZero
methods.description: Checks if an integer value is zero or positive (>= 0).
